name: Cotton TLR
positioning: Specialized's 320 TPI cotton-casing tubeless-ready race tire.
caveats: Specialized labels it 'Racing Only': a race-day tire with less protection than its training tires.
The lab rating Specialized cites is not recorded here because the test itself was not read.

origin.basis: Specialized Bicycle Components, Inc. publishes the US store, with California consumer disclosures in the page footer.

manufacturing.basis: Specialized does not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Sold by Specialized's US store; Specialized dealers in other regions were not checked in this pass.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.
